echoParts: There is no one who understands
verseText: As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one. There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.”
meaning: It is written in many places in the Bible that no one is truly righteous. Nobody is perfect. Nobody always does what God says is right. That's why we need Jesus to save us.

recall.question: “Righteous” means right in God’s sight. How many people are righteous on their own?

meaning.question: What does this verse help us understand about our need for Jesus?
choices: We all need Him to save us from sin
Only really bad sinners need Him
God doesn't mind if we sin a little

application.prompt: Many people don't worry about their own sin. They think, “At least I’m better than someone else.” But we all need Jesus to forgive us and change our hearts. How does this verse help us understand how God feels about sin?
